_about: Re-runnable queries for the Fund Explorer pattern hunt. One intent per query. Mobbin: mode deep, platform ios, hold task_intent constant. Written by Noor, 22 Sep 2026, from a session without a browser — none of these has been run yet; files[] fill in when the main session saves the images to studio/fund-explorer/refs/.
task_intent: Patterns for a chat-led, advisor-facing fund explorer: how a typed sentence and a visible browse surface (list, filters, compare, fund page) stay in sync on a 375pt phone.

queries.query: Amazon app: tap Rufus in bottom nav, ask a question, chat sheet rises over results, swipe down to dismiss back to search results
queries.why: The exact bottom-sheet-over-a-surface gesture V2 needs, mirrored (chat over browse)

queries.query: Google Maps search results bottom sheet at peek height showing count and top results, map visible behind, no scrim
queries.why: Three-detent sheet grammar: peek / half / full over a live canvas

queries.query: Redfin conversational home search: describe a home in words, assistant reports no matches, user relaxes a criterion, list updates beside the map
queries.why: Zero-result recovery in words while the browse surface stays on screen

queries.query: Zillow search results after typing a natural language query, showing how the parsed criteria appear above the listing list
queries.why: Does typing produce visible, removable filter chips

queries.query: Spotify Prompted Playlist: describe what to hear, generate playlist, tap Refine, tap Edit prompt, playlist updates
queries.why: Two refine doors (edit the sentence vs edit the list) and whether the list stays visible while typing

queries.query: Perplexity answer screen with numbered source chips inline and a collapsed Sources expander above the answer
queries.why: Mobile collapse of a parallel region into a count

queries.query: Perplexity shopping answer with product cards showing price, pros and cons, and a View more button opening a detail panel
queries.why: Card-in-thread that opens to a panel without leaving the thread

queries.query: Booking.com hotel results filter sheet with an AI text box at the top, type a request, filter options check themselves, apply button shows count
queries.why: A typed field living inside a conventional filter sheet — the cheapest V1/V2 bridge

queries.query: KAYAK Ask AI chat panel with flight results list updating beside the conversation on a phone
queries.why: The V2 spine (chat + live real results page); no written source described the mobile layout

queries.query: Airbnb filters sheet with price histogram, amenity checkboxes and a sticky bottom button reading Show N places
queries.why: Live-count apply button, exact copy and placement

queries.query: Zerodha Coin mutual fund filters full screen: sort by, categories, risk, ratings, fund house, index funds only toggle, View funds button with count
queries.why: The Indian convention for a filter sheet with a counted apply button (owner has board #05; this pulls the rest of the flow)

queries.query: Zerodha Coin mutual fund detail page: NAV chart with range chips, sticky header on scroll, returns table, holdings section, invest button
queries.why: A one-scroll fund page to set beside Groww's tabbed one (board #10–15)

queries.query: INDmoney compare mutual funds screen with Pros and Cons block above a side by side table of returns, expense ratio and risk ratios
queries.why: Verdict-before-grid on a phone; how many columns survive at 375

queries.query: Nike Running Shoe Finder: eight single-choice questions, progress indicator, results page with up to three shoes and compare
queries.why: A stepped funnel that ends in a shortlist, and how a step is revised

queries.query: smallcase Discover screen with collections row, filter chips for volatility, minimum investment and strategy, sort control, portfolio cards with CAGR
queries.why: Collections plus facet chips on one screen — a V1 list head

queries.query: sticky section navigation mobile fund detail page
queries.why: Aesthetic seed for the scroll strip on the fund page

queries.query: dumbbell chart two series mobile finance
queries.why: Aesthetic seed for the two-fund compare chart, one accent
Aesthetic signal only; not usability evidence

queries.query: filter bottom sheet apply button result count
queries.why: Aesthetic signal only; not usability evidence
